title: Understanding Mean Cubed Error
text: The Mean Cubed Error is calculated by taking the average of the cube of the differences between the actual and predicted values. How does cubing a number affect its sign and magnitude?

title: Impact of Cubing on Error
text: Cubing a number amplifies its magnitude, especially for larger numbers. Consider how this might affect predictions that are slightly off versus those that are significantly off.

title: Comparing Predictions
text: Which prediction error would be penalized more in Mean Cubed Error: a small error or a large error?

title: Closer vs. Farther Predictions
text: Think about how the cubing operation affects positive and negative errors. Does it treat them differently?

title: Effect of Cubing on Error Sign
text: Does cubing a negative error make it positive or keep it negative?
